overview: This enum labels the kind of hit a damage row represents, which decides which combat rules and bonuses apply.

None.simple: This hit has no attack category.
None.technical: uint8 value 0 and the Damage row constructor default. No traced consumer branches on this type. Exported rows still apply their raw damage fields.

NormalAttack.simple: A basic attack that counts toward normal-hit rules.
NormalAttack.technical: uint8 value 1. The receiver is added to the attacker normal-hit list. This type enables normal-attack equipment effects for cursed-energy gain, guard durability damage and move slow. It also keeps normal-hit reaction eligibility.

CursedEnergyAttack_1.technical: uint8 value 2. It qualifies for cursed-energy hit-effect aura colors, cursed-energy equipment bonuses and the matching binding-vow bonus. It avoids casual down-rate correction. CP_230 adds a character-specific adapt gate.

CursedEnergyAttack_2.technical: uint8 value 3. It shares the cursed-energy aura, equipment and binding-vow paths with the first category. It avoids casual down-rate correction. CP_110 refuses the matching adapt check when its specific passive buff is absent.

SuperCursedEnergyAttack.simple: A powerful cursed-energy strike with special knockout rules.
SuperCursedEnergyAttack.technical: uint8 value 4. A finishing hit of this type uses the knockout voice branch. It enables binding-vow super damage bonuses and CP_020 shockwaves. CN_230 and CN_240 include it in consecutive numeric range tests.

SpecialTagCombo.simple: A linked-team combo strike with its own bonuses.
SpecialTagCombo.technical: uint8 value 5. CN_240 gives the attacker a matching adaptation debuff when this type lands. Battle systems add binding-vow and equipment special-tag-combo damage bonuses only for this type. It also uses the knockout voice branch and several controller exclusions.

Debuff.simple: A hit used mainly to apply a status effect.
Debuff.technical: uint8 value 6. The receiver hit-response interception and normal hit-slow are skipped for it. Tag-combo partner search is skipped. Armor and down processing is skipped when the damage type is None.

BindingVows.simple: A hit tied to a binding-vow cost.
BindingVows.technical: uint8 value 7. The exported Damage row BINDING_VOWS_DEAD is the only supplied row with this type and is requested by name when binding-vow completion kills a rival. No reconstructed source branch compares the type value directly.

Invalid.technical: uint8 value 255. No reconstructed consumer branches on it and no exported row uses it. Its meaning is limited to the declared sentinel.

notes: CursedEnergyAttack_1 and CursedEnergyAttack_2 are distinct labels that share most equipment paths. CP_110 and CP_230 add character-specific gates.
SuperCursedEnergyAttack, SpecialTagCombo and Debuff are three consecutive types used by numeric range checks in CN_230 and CN_240.

Supplied Damage exports contain 552 NormalAttack rows, 264 CursedEnergyAttack_2 rows, 250 CursedEnergyAttack_1 rows, 53 None rows, 47 SuperCursedEnergyAttack rows, 31 SpecialTagCombo rows, 3 Debuff rows and 1 BindingVows row.
No Invalid row appears in the supplied exports.
